UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.ChangePatrolPat:
Determines how often the spawner will select a new random Patrol Path within its Patrol Path Group.
If NEVER, the device will always use the first Patrol Path in the Patrol Path Group.
UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.CanBeGivenComma: Determines if Guard can be given commands or not.
UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.CanAssignToDisa:
Determines if guards can be assigned patrol paths that are disabled to use in the future. 
The guard will fallback to using the patrol around device behavior until the path is enabled.
If OFF, disabled paths will be ignored unless all paths are disabled.
UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.ShouldRandomlyS:
Determines if the device should randomly select a path to use.
If OFF, the device will select the path (in order of their indexes if they have been set) that has not had a guard spawned on it, which resets after a guard has spawned on each Patrol Path in the Patrol Group.
NOTE: If multiple paths have the same index they will be randomly ordered between themselves.
UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.EnableResumingP:
Determines if the guards should resume patrolling their path if it was disabled and then enabled.
If OFF, the guards must be assigned a path through a path's "Assign AI To Path" function to continue path following.
UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.ShowSpawnRadius: Determines if we should show a preview cylinder of the spawn radius in Edit mode.

UserOptionDefinition.Device_GuardSpawner_V2_C.ChangePatrolPat: Determines the amount of time of new spawned Guards will be selecting the Patrol Path. After it ends, new spawned Guards will randomly select Patrol Paths. This won't impact Guards that have been spawned already.
